title: Audio Guidance & Formats
lede: What goes in, what comes out, and how to keep quality high.
body:
At a glance
  • Text and audio inputs.
  • Internal vs output formats.
  • Bitrate, normalization, and length tips.

Inputs

Text chapters are plain text; voice samples are common audio formats. See File Formats.

Internal vs output formats

Studio renders to WAV internally, then exports MP3 or M4B. Working in WAV keeps quality high until the final export.

Quality tips

  • Pick a sensible export bitrate for spoken word.
  • Let Studio normalize levels for consistent loudness.
  • Keep per-segment text within the engine's chunk limit.
